Product, finance, architecture & operations.

The stack
01 — Product / CPO

Early-stage product & reinvention.

ASX-listed Chief Customer & Product Officer. Four-time co-founder. Specialist in early-stage product and product reinvention — connecting customer problems to solutions that fit the business and its goals. Leads with product, always.

02 — Finance / CFO

The P&L seat, not the back office.

Interim CFO for a cashflow-challenged, superficially profitable business. Rebuilt finance ops as part of the value stream — a CFO/COO hybrid, not a back-office reporting function.

03 — Operations / COO

Operating-model design & delivery.

Turnaround and growth-stage org design (most alive at 10–50 people). Leads transformation working groups that challenge the status quo with empathy — design-and-build, not axe-wielding cost-cutting.

04 — Architecture / CTO

Enterprise to AI-native build.

Enterprise Solution Architect across government and financial services. Lead dev on the Mastercard payment gateway. Today builds AI-native agents (pi, Claude Code) that execute across the stack — not just advise.
